description: Small-shape view of the same CUDA public linalg API surface: the 82 cases whose largest matrix dimension is at most 128. `small` is a shape class, not a measured classification: device kernel time is a small fraction of each measurement here, so these rows are per-call launch and synchronization overhead diagnostics rather than GPU throughput. They are never comparable with, or averaged together with, the large-shape rows of `gpu/linalg_public_api_throughput` (tenferro-rs #2087). Issue 155. Rows here are lower than on pages published before this harness change because the harness used to open the CUDA engine once per case inside the timed region and now opens it once per arm, so the difference is removed harness cost and not a change in the kernels.
